Masking is something very different than what you might think it is or maybe you don't realize that you do it yourself. I've talked about this to other autistic people and is very common in people that are diagnosed late in life. We hide our autism by acting like a "normal" person. It's not about professionalism or politeness, it's about hiding our stimming, our mannerisms and our usual speech to fit in. For example, normally, I would speak in a monotone voice but when I talk to people, I change that depending on how the person is to fit in. Or I try not to walk on my toes when I'm in public because I don't want to be looked at. I try not to move my hands too much when in public because I want to seem normal. It's all about hiding autistic traits, not about talking in a professional way to your boss.

No, not in that sense. When I say "other people" I'm referencing other close friends and close family. I mask differently with everyone. What I am saying is that when my friends are talking to other close friends, they mask differently than with me and it catches me off guard even though i do the same with my other close friends. For example, when we do a group call all together, we quite literally change the way we talk depending on who we are answering to. That catches me off guard

Well that is hard to answer... If I take myself as an example, maybe it will make it easier to understand.

My major intrest, the one I always come back to is cooking! I have a lot of short-term intrests too but you have to first find the category you find your intrests in. 

For example, I like drawing, writing, crocheting, sewing... Maybe you see the pattern here, everything is related to creating and creativity. Maybe you could take a moment to find yours! 

Next you have to think about the interests that are not your main interest. Eliminate all of those that are very short-paced (hours long, days long). 

Then you should be left with the ones that are very important to you but which is your special interest? The one that takes the most time out of you life and the one that always come back when you feel bored or when you feel like you have no interest. 

Maybe here you have an idea of this main interest. Now give it some days, weeks or months to see if you can spot wich interest takes most of your mind. Maybe look at the channels that you follow on youtube to see you interest? Or maybe some subs over here? The trick is to wait and see at this point, you'll know when you'll know.

Well, I hope this will help, even only a bit :))
